en: The next location of the Darkmoon Faire has not been finalized yet, but when it is you and I will be the first to know!

Cenarius fights at my side. Illidan sits atop his throne in the Outland - brooding. I am afraid that the loss to Arthas proved to be his breaking point. Madness has embraced him, Remulos. He replays the events in his mind a thousand times per day, but in his mind, he is the victor and Arthas is utterly defeated. He is too far gone, old friend. I fear that the time may soon come that our bond is tested and it will not be as it was at the Well in Zin-Azshari.
How dare you?!
Let's find out.
Yes my $g son : daughter;? What can I assist you with?

Do ye have the potential to be a skilled hunter?  Well $gladdie : lassie;, only time will tell.  Just don't ye go shooting at apples atop peoples' heads till ye've spoken with Regnus o'er in the Hall of Arms.
Vile goblins... anything for a gold coin.

The main threat Thrall wishes dealt with is the Burning Blade--members of the Horde that have given their loyalty to the demons. They seek to practice their dark magic and care little for Thrall's vision of the Horde's future here in Kalimdor.
Jin'rokh, my Zandalar Vindicator's Armguards have gone missing. Do you have a spare set?

Greetings, $c - I'm a Commendation Officer acting on behalf of the Darkspear tribe.  It is my duty to assist adventurers who have received Horde Commendation Signets.$B$BI accept signets in different quantities, but the most beneficial exchange for you is to hand in a set of ten at once.  I will enter your deeds into our records when you hand in your signets.  As a result, you will earn recognition from the Darkspear tribe for your duty and service.
Travelers and adventurers make haste to the town circle and take advantage of Antonio's wonderful prices! Come one, come all!
You are gonna want to head over to Old Town and drop by the Protective Hide if you are lookin' to learn skinning.
Come speak with me, and what once was cloudy shall become crystal clear.

Zug zug, brave $c!  I have the finest bred wolf mounts for you to peruse.  You'll not find another animal with the level of endurance and survival instincts that the wolf has anywhere!  Please, inspect them for yourself.
%s goes back to work, oblivious to everything around him.
Move back and hold the line!  We cannot fail or all will be lost!
Please be patient, we will call your name when it is your turn. We are helping people in the order they appear to us on our screen. $n!
What can I do?
What must be done?
%s is enraged!
I, like my brother, honor those who honor their ancestors.  It brings me great joy to share my crafting secrets to disciples of the Lunar Festival!
Despair, mortals! Your doom has come!
Don't try to teleport to one of your enemies' cities.  It won't work - we may all be friendly here, but back home old grudges remain...
While nothing can change the past, time can heal all wounds. Thank you for showing me that it is possible, $n. I wish you well.
This is my test gossip.
Ah, I see you toil with relics of the past.
You have learned the fundamentals of making potions, but further study requires greater commitment. Prove your dedication by carrying out a task for me.
Father?  Are you proud of me now? HAHAH!
You should have stayed home.

"Taurahe?"$B$BThe tauren druid looks at you expectantly, but it is clear you cannot verbally communicate with her.  Undaunted, she points to herself and smiles.  She points at you and smiles once more.  She finally motions several times down the path to the south.$B$BPerhaps she is indicating that there is a druid you can speak to further down the road?
Chief Bloodhoof, this may sound like an odd request... but I have a young ward who is quite shy.  You are a hero to him, and he asked me to get your hoofprint.
